historical_record.description: A permit was sought for alterations: 5-ply tar and gravel roofing and repair fire damage to flats, estimated at $1,000. Chas. Coburn was named as contractor.

Sold for $43,500, deed recorded February 16, 1967. The Redevelopment Agency's appraisers, filing it as a comparable sale, described two one-story-and-basement wood-frame cottages: 628 Baker in front (seven rooms, built 1890) and 626 Baker at the rear (five rooms, built 1907), built 1890 and 1907.
